steps.npc: I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.

steps.npc: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
Have you thought about painting the building?

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.

steps.npc: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
Could I get one of those rune platebodies?

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: As a little thank you for the help!

steps.npc: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: I can't wait to complete the purchase!

steps.npc: It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
Do you have any plans for it?

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!

steps.npc: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: Ah!! Why did you do that?

steps.npc: I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.

steps.speaker: Oziach
steps.text: Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.

standard-dialogue-talk-to-if-oziach-has-.npc: Sorry [player name], I'm talking to Oziach right now.

cutscenes-when-the-player-attempts-to-tr.text: A cutscene starts. Spooky music track plays.

cutscenes-when-the-player-attempts-to-tr.npc: I'm going to head back to the office.

cutscenes-when-the-player-attempts-to-tr.speaker: Oziach
cutscenes-when-the-player-attempts-to-tr.text: Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!

cutscenes-when-the-player-attempts-to-tr.npc: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.speaker: Oziach
cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: So many ghosts... I need some help!

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.npc: Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.speaker: Oziach
cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.npc: Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.speaker: Oziach
cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.speaker: Oziach
cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.speaker: Oziach
cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: They will help with the ghost problem!

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.npc: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
I'll be doing the final paperwork.

cutscenes-after-the-player-and-iffie-hav.text: The cutscene continues without the Estate agent.
